set.body:
Outcome: DL1 recall detail inventory. Each recall unit is split into detail atoms with exact canonical UTF-16 spans and a kind (action/event, participant, place, time, perceptual, dialogue/reported speech, thought/emotion, external). Start from the interview module's atom vocabulary rather than a parallel one.
Admission: spans inside the unit, non-overlapping, uncovered share reported. LLM output is a proposal (rule 13).
Exit: on fresh units, atom agreement with blind human detail coding reported against human-human agreement. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl1-recall-detail-inventory.
set.title: [detail-mapping] DL1 recall detail inventory
